jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations and Total Rewards
jobs.desc:
Role Overview
Based in our Cork office, this role sits at the intersection of people operations and total rewards, with global scope and genuine ownership. You will manage the systems, processes, and programmes that underpin how we attract, retain, and reward our people worldwide bringing operational rigour and strategic thinking in equal measure.
You will work closely with HR leadership, Finance, and Legal, acting as a trusted partner to HRBPs and business leaders globally. You will play a central role in driving the AI-enabled transformation of the People function - identifying opportunities to automate workflows, augment decision-making, and redesign how the team operates day to day using emerging AI tools and capabilities.
Responsibilities
People Operations
Lead the AI transformation of People Operations evaluating, piloting, and embedding AI tools across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and policy management to compensation modelling and people analytics, and building the team's capability to work effectively alongside AI.
Own and continuously improve global HR operations including HRIS (UKG) administration, data integrity, process documentation, and AI-enabled workflow automation - ensuring a seamless employee experience at every stage of the lifecycle.
Manage and evolve HR policies globally, ensuring compliance with local employment law across multiple jurisdictions while maintaining consistency in global people practices.
Build and maintain people analytics reporting to support data-driven decisions by HR leadership and business partners.
Own the People team's technology stack, working closely with IT and Data teams to integrate systems, safeguard data, and unlock new capabilities.
Manage and develop a small global team, setting priorities and building capability across time zones.
Total Rewards
Lead the design, administration, and communication of global compensation programmes - including salary structures, bonus plans, and equity ensuring they are competitive, equitable, and aligned to business strategy.
Own and evolve the benefits portfolio with responsibility for managing vendor relationships, renewals, and regional programme design. As the company continues to grow, this role will play a key part in extending our benefits offering into additional regions ensuring local market norms and regulatory requirements are met at every stage.
Drive the annual compensation review cycle end-to-end, from market benchmarking and budget modelling to manager guidance and employee communications.
Conduct and interpret compensation benchmarking surveys (Radford) to keep pay ranges current and defensible, and advise on offer competitiveness and internal equity.
Lead pay equity analysis and gender pay gap reporting.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of progressive HR experience, with meaningful depth in both people operations and compensation and/or benefits.
Proficiency with HRIS platforms (UKG, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent) and strong analytical skills - comfortable building models and presenting data-driven recommendations.
Total compensation design and strategy experience, including salary structures, bonus plans, equity (RSUs, stock options), and benefits with the ability to architect, communicate, and govern total reward frameworks in a global, multi-jurisdiction environment.
Technology or hardware industry is preferred, with familiarity with the compensation structures, equity programmes, and talent dynamics typical of a global tech environment.
Experience applying AI tools to HR processes whether through workflow automation, predictive analytics, or process redesign with a practical, hands-on approach to identifying and implementing new capabilities.
Understanding of global employment law, including Irish employment legislation, GDPR, and the EU Pay Transparency Directive.
Experience managing global benefits programmes across multiple countries and vendors, with an understanding of regional market norms.
Clear, confident communication - able to translate complex compensation mechanics into plain language for managers and employees, and present recommendations credibly to senior stakeholders.
Strong project management skills - able to lead programmes from design to delivery, manage multiple workstreams, and follow through consistently.
Collaborative and inclusive working style - effective across time zones, able to build trust with distributed teams.
Proven experience managing and developing a small team, with the ability to set direction, coach individuals, and drive performance in a global environment.
Preferred Qualifications
A third-level qualification in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field is desirable, though equivalent professional experience and/or CIPD qualification will be equally considered.
Experience in a US-headquartered company.
Company Statement/Values
At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.
We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the
Next Gear
by living our values: we
Dare to Transform
the future,
Connect and Delight
our customers,
Communicate Courageously
with each other and collaborate to
Win It Together
. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture.
We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity.
NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Premium Watch Sales Specialist
jobs.desc:
Sell premium and luxury watches at sea, earn up to 6% commission on watch sales, and build relationships with guests from around the world.
We’re looking for experienced
Watch Sales Specialists
to join our onboard retail teams, working on cruise ships around the world.
This is a unique opportunity for someone with proven experience selling
luxury watches.
You’ll need strong product knowledge, confidence with premium and Swiss watch brands, and the ability to guide guests through a considered, high-value purchase with expertise and care.
Working at sea is very different from working on the high street. You’ll live and work onboard, become part of a close-knit team, and have the opportunity to develop guest relationships across the cruise. Some guests may buy in the moment. Others may return several times before making a decision. Your role is to guide that journey with patience, knowledge and strong commercial instinct.
This is a chance to combine luxury watch sales, travel and excellent earning potential, with the opportunity to earn up to 6% commission on premium watch sales, on top of salary.
About Harding+
Harding+ is a leading cruise retail business, working closely with cruise line partners and brand partners to make every cruise better. Our onboard boutiques offer guests a carefully selected range of products across categories including watches, fine jewellery, fashion, beauty, liquor, confectionery and logo products.
We are proud to have been recognised as Cruise Retailer of the Year in 2022, 2023 and 2025, reflecting our focus on outstanding service, strong brand partnerships and memorable guest experiences.
What You’ll Do
As a
Watch Sales Specialist
, you’ll be responsible for delivering a premium guest experience and maximising watch sales onboard. You’ll welcome guests into the boutique, understand what they are looking for, and use your product knowledge to recommend pieces that feel relevant to their style, occasion or collection.
You’ll confidently introduce guests to different watch brands, explain features and value, invite them to handle and try pieces, and help them imagine ownership. You’ll know when to give space, when to continue the conversation, and when to move naturally towards commitment.
You’ll also support onboard events, presentations and promotions, using these moments to create interest, generate leads and bring guests back into the boutique. Alongside this, you’ll maintain excellent product presentation, support stock and compliance processes, and share your knowledge with the wider team.
This role is about more than product knowledge. It requires presence, composure and the ability to build trust with guests who may be considering a significant purchase.
What You’ll Bring
We’re looking for someone with proven experience selling luxury watches. This role would suit someone who has worked with premium or Swiss watch brands and understands how to sell through product knowledge, storytelling, trust and a consultative guest experience. You will have:
Proven experience selling luxury watches
Strong knowledge of premium and Swiss watch brands
Experience guiding customers through high-value or considered purchases
Motivation and ambition to achieve and exceed sales targets
Confidence delivering product presentations, seminars or guest events
A flexible, team-focused attitude and the ability to adapt to life at sea
Fluency in English; additional languages would be an advantage
A good level of physical fitness, as the role involves being active throughout the day
What You’ll Get
Competitive salary, plus up to 6% commission – all take home pay
Included accommodation and meals provided onboard
No household bills while you are working at sea
Support with necessary visas and seafaring documents
Dedicated in-house training across sales, product and brand knowledge
The opportunity to travel the world while earning
Contracts of up to 6 months onboard, usually followed by 1 to 2 months at home between contracts
On selected cruise lines, the opportunity to travel independently after your contract, with support for your return travel home afterwards
Ready to take your watch sales career further? Apply now!
If you have proven luxury watch sales experience, strong product knowledge and the commercial confidence to sell in a unique cruise retail environment, this could be your next move.
Bring your expertise, your confidence and your passion for watches, and start your next adventure with Harding+.

jobs.title: Engineering Project Manager
jobs.desc:
Summary
Imagine the impact you could have. At Apple, innovation is more than a goal — it’s our way of life. Here, bold ideas become transformative products, services, and customer experiences. We thrive on collaboration, turning individual creativity into collective brilliance, and we believe that when passionate people come together, there’s no limit to what can be achieved.
Apple’s IS&T Retail Engineering team builds and operates the technology behind Apple’s global retail experience. We’re looking for a driven Engineering Project Manager with deep experience in fast-paced e-commerce or software development environments and a proven ability to deliver exceptional results. If you’re excited by the challenge of delivering high-quality work at scale, we invite you to explore what’s possible with us.
Description
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Project Manager (EPM) to deliver complex engineering projects from initiation to completion, on time and within budget. We pride ourselves on offering customers the biggest range of products around. And that's not just food, but everything from clothes and kettles to financial services.

Whats in it for you?
We offer excellent benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. These include but aren’t limited to:
Competitive Salary
Bonus Scheme*
Our Virtual GP service provides free and confidential access to an online GP through video GP consultations, and online prescription service for colleagues. The service is also available to families of colleagues who live at the same address for a reduced cost.
24/7 access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) for you and family members for in the moment emotional support along with free access to a range of wellbeing services supporting you under our new Wellbeing First approach of Body, Mind and Life.

nd
Clubcard available.*
Life Assurance
Pension Plan*

Paid Family Leave
Bike to Work

About Us
Our vision at Tesco is to become every customer’s favourite way to shop, whether they are at home or out on the move.  Our core purpose is “Serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day”.  Serving means more than a transactional relationship with our customers.  It means acting as a responsible and sustainable business for all stakeholders, for the communities we are part of, and for the planet. Through initiatives like the Tesco Community Fund, our association with Children’s Health Foundation, our partnership with FoodCloud and our Stronger Starts programme, we have supported over 21,000 community groups, raised over €7.5 million for medical equipment, and provided almost 15 million meals nationwide, to those living in food insecurity.
Tesco has operated in the Irish retail market since 1997, and with 190+ stores nationwide, we employ over 13,000 people in cities and towns around Ireland, supporting almost 45,000 jobs directly and indirectly. We partner with over 500 Irish suppliers - of which almost three-quarters are small and medium enterprises - which in turn supports almost 13,000 farming families around Ireland. Tesco is the single largest buyer of Irish food and drink in the world, buying €1.6 Billion a year; more than any other single country in the European Union, more than even the USA which you perceive as a massive buyer of Irish food.
We work closely with suppliers across Ireland who are dedicated to making the best products for our customers and this is reflected in the numerous awards our products have won over the years including Blás Na hÉireann, World Steak Challenge and Great Taste Awards.
We are proud to have an inclusive culture at Tesco where everyone truly feels able to be themselves. It is embedded in our values: we treat people how they want to be treated.   At Tesco, we not only celebrate diversity, but recognise the value and opportunity it brings.  We always want our colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work and we are committed to helping them be at their best.
We know life looks a little different for each of us. That’s why at Tesco, we always welcome chats about flexible working. Some people are at the start of their careers, some want the freedom to do the things they love. Others are going through life-changing moments like becoming a carer, nearing retirement, adapting to parenthood, or something else. So, talk to us throughout your application about how we can support.
Tesco is committed to celebrating diversity and everyone is welcome at Tesco. We're committed to providing a fully inclusive recruitment process, allowing candidates the opportunity to thrive and inform us of any reasonable adjustments they may require. For further information on the accessibility support we can offer, please click http://roi.tesco-careers.com/accessibility/

tescoireland.recruitment@tesco.ie

jobs.title: Computer Aided Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
A global leader in semiconductor technology is looking for an experienced Staff CAD Engineer to join its Graphics team, contributing to the development of next-generation GPU technology.
This is an opportunity to work on advanced silicon designs, developing innovative flows, methodologies, and algorithms to optimise power, performance, and area (PPA) across cutting-edge GPU cores.
You will collaborate closely with graphics microarchitecture, design, and implementation teams, helping drive improvements across the full ASIC development lifecycle.
The role requires a fundamental understanding of RTL design and the ASIC development flow from RTL to GDS, including synthesis, static timing analysis, formal verification, physical design, and ECO generation and verification. You will collaborate with design, technology, power, implementation, sign-off, and post-silicon teams to drive PPA improvements across GPU cores.
Key Skills and Experience
Experience in the following areas would be highly advantageous:
Implementation and delivery of GPU cores from RTL through to GDSII.
Development of semi-custom design flows and methodologies.
Identifying opportunities to improve existing flows and processes.
Proficiency in Verilog and SystemVerilog.
RTL synthesis using physically aware tools.
Managing design constraints relating to power, timing, clocking, and interfaces.
Formal verification for RTL-to-netlist and netlist-to-netlist checks.
Clock tree analysis and optimisation.
ECO methodologies for functional and timing fixes.
Managing design targets and trade-offs across power, performance, and area (PPA).
Preferred Qualifications
5–7 years of experience developing methodologies to improve PPA.
Fundamental understanding of digital design and RTL development.
Hands-on experience with EDA tools such as Synopsys Fusion Compiler, RTL Architect, PrimePower, PrimeTime, and Prime Closure.
Experience developing scripts using UNIX Shell, Python, Perl, and/or TCL.
Strong analytical and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently.
A highly motivated, collaborative approach, with a strong focus on deliverable quality and customer requirements.
Education Requirements
Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering.
Preferred: Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment
jobs.desc:
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – Ireland
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – About the Company
Our client is a well-established international business in the environmental services sector, providing advanced industrial purification and filtration solutions that help companies reduce their environmental impact across a wide range of industries. Active in multiple European markets and growing quickly, the company is now building out its commercial team in Ireland and is looking for a driven sales professional to help expand its client base.
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – The Opportunity
This is a genuine new-business "hunter" role. Demand for sustainable industrial purification is rising fast, and you will be the person opening doors — identifying, winning and developing new clients across key Irish industries, and matching the right technical solution to each prospect. You will own your territory commercially, with the backing of in-house application specialists and an internal sales team.
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – Key Responsibilities
Win new business: generate, develop and close opportunities within strategic target markets in your territory, including representing the company at industry trade events during the year.
Shape the solution: combine your own technical and commercial judgement with the support of in-house specialists to tailor proposals to each client's process and requirements.
Be on the road: regular travel within your territory (around three days a week is typical), with the occasional overnight stay each month and periodic visits to the group's head office in mainland Europe.
Manage your pipeline: keep opportunities up to date in a sales-focused CRM platform and maintain consistent follow-up with contacts across purchasing, process engineering and plant management.
Handle quotations: working alongside the internal sales team, prepare and present offers and respond to incoming enquiries quickly and professionally.
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – Candidate Profile
Based in Ireland, ideally within reach of the main industrial hubs, with the flexibility to cover the wider region.
A proven sales track record (at least 3 years) with a clear focus on acquiring new clients.
An existing network in a relevant field is a real advantage — prior experience in sectors such as chemicals, water treatment, biogas, soil remediation or broader industrial and environmental processes will let you get up to speed quickly and bring contacts with you.
Strong technical aptitude: able to grasp industrial processes quickly and explain complex solutions in clear terms.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
Self-motivated and resilient, with a true hunter mentality suited to a longer, consultative sales cycle.
Comfortable working independently from a home office while staying well connected to colleagues and management.
Happy to travel frequently, with flexibility for the occasional overnight stay.
Fluent in English at native level; additional languages are a plus.
If you don't tick every box but you're confident in your ability to win new business and would thrive in a collaborative, standards-driven culture, we'd still encourage you to apply.
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – Compensation & Benefits
A competitive base salary, set according to your experience.
A package that includes a car allowance, mileage allowance, smartphone and mobile subscription, pension provision and a sales-related bonus.
Home-based working with a high degree of autonomy, supported by regular contact with your team and manager and periodic team meetings in mainland Europe.
A generous annual holiday allowance.
Strong investment in your development, with a wide range of training opportunities.
A structured, tailored onboarding plan to get you up and running smoothly from day one.
You will join a team of dedicated sales colleagues across Europe and report into regional sales leadership.
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – How to Apply
Interested? Apply with an up-to-date CV and we'll be in touch to discuss the opportunity in confidence. All applications are handled with the strictest discretion.
Sales Manager – Industrial Water & Gas Treatment – Recruiter Disclaimer
This search is managed exclusively by Nicolas Vikelis on behalf of our client. The client's identity remains confidential at this stage and is disclosed to shortlisted candidates at the first interview. By applying, you consent to your details being shared with our client for the purposes of this recruitment process.

jobs.desc:
About Kinaxis
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
Location
This is a remote role. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland
About The Team
The Employee Relations Specialist, EMEA is r esponsible for providing expert employee relations support across the EMEA region. Acting as a trusted advisor to managers, HR Business Partners, Legal, and key stakeholders, this role manages complex employee relations matters, supports organizational change initiatives, and ensures compliance with local employment legislation and consultation requirements across multiple EMEA jurisdictions .
The successful candidate will bring significant employee relations experience supporting EMEA employees and leaders, including practical knowledge of employee representative structures, Works Councils, consultation obligations, and country-specific employment requirements.
What you will do
Manage complex employee relations casework across EMEA, including performance management, probation reviews and extensions, disciplinary matters, grievances, investigations, and terminations.
Provide coaching and guidance to managers on complex employee relations matters, employment legislation, global and local HR policies, and HR processes.
Support managers in navigating sensitive employee matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally compliant outcomes.
Conduct thorough, objective, and timely investigations into workplace concerns, policy violations, misconduct allegations, and employee complaints.
Support the establishment of and ongoing collaboration with employee representative bodies, including Works Councils .
Manage consultation activities and ensure compliance with local statutory requirements and employee representative obligations.
Conduct country-specific legal processes as required .
Guide leaders and employees through the accommodation process, ensuring equitable treatment and consistent application of policy and employment legislation.
Identify trends and themes across employee relations activity and escalate complex or high-risk matters as appropriate.
Support organizational change initiatives, restru ctures, acquisitions, workforce reductions, and business transformation activities.
Partner with Legal, HR Business Partners, and business leaders on complex employee relations matters.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of employee relations processes, documentation, manager capability, and best practices across EMEA.
What we are looking for
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources , Business Administration, Employment Relations, Labour Relations, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of Employee Relations experience supporting multiple EMEA countries.
Demonstrated experience with Works Councils, employee representative bodies, and consultation processes.
E xperience managing EMEA-based investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, performance management, probation management, and terminations.
Strong knowledge of employment legislation and employee relations practices across EMEA jurisdictions .
Experience supporting organizational change initiatives and restructures in EMEA .
Experience partnering with Legal, HR Advisors/ Business Partners, and leaders on complex employee relations matters.
Ability to analyze data and trends to identify potential employee relations issues and develop proactive solutions.
Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels within the organization.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with employees, managers, and senior leadership.
Ability to work in a fast-paced organization and manage multiple priorities
Ability to maintain a high level of discretion, confidentiality, and integrity
Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and cultures.
Work With Impact:
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
Work with Fortune 500 Brands:
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Electrical Engineer (Transmission & Distribution)
jobs.desc:
Interested in smart manufacturing? Want to influence the power grid of the future? Tackle climate change?
Launch your career with NeoDyne and open a world of opportunities!
Company Overview
NeoDyne is a leading engineering company specialising in industrial automation, digital manufacturing, and electrical engineering solutions. We develop high-availability automation and electrical systems for mission-critical industries, including pharmaceutical manufacturing, data centres, and energy infrastructure, ensuring continuous operation and compliance. Our expertise extend across power generation, natural gas transmission, and high-voltage system design, delivering robust solutions that strengthen critical infrastructure.
Within our
Transmission & Distribution
team, we deliver mission-critical design packages that transform the reliability, availability, and efficiency of the energy network, moving it towards a greener, more sustainable future. Department highlights include:
Driving complex design delivery: We design AIS/GIS substations from 20kV to 220kV and contestable build and non-contestable stations in the range of 40 to 550MVA CCGT. Connections include conventional and renewable Power Generation, Peaking, Battery Storage, DS3 and Solar PV plants and large demand loads such as data centres and process plants.
Delivery of high-complexity design frameworks: NeoDyne is a gas network design framework supplier, playing a significant role in providing electrical and instrumentation engineering services for the on-shore Natural Gas Industry and Regulated gas utility sector in Ireland and the UK. Our expertise include Compressor Station, AGI Electrical & Instrumentation design, Fiscal and non-Fiscal metering, and Cathodic Protection.
With a team of 220+ skilled engineers, our expertise spans the entire project lifecycle, from design and implementation to commissioning and operations. From our offices in Ireland, the UK, Romania, and the US, we operate on a global scale, combining technical expertise with local delivery. We support customers across Europe, North America, and Asia, delivering tailored engineering services that drive long-term success.
Position Summary
NeoDyne are recruiting a
Graduate Electrical Engineer
to join our expanding engineering teams. Our graduate programme is all about learning new and developing your existing skills. Over a two-year period, you will be placed in projects where you get to do meaningful work and contribute to the business.
This Graduate opportunity is offered as a full-time permanent contract, based at our
Cork Office
, with an excellent salary and benefits package. If successful, you will enjoy NeoDyne's "People First" company culture, built on mutual respect, trust, and honesty, where each individual actively contributes as a valued team member.
What might I be doing?
Projects could include preparation of coordinated drawings covering all aspects of installations, including mechanical, electrical, instrumentation and structural elements. More specifically, you will be producing Gas Transmission AGI Design including, Electrical Layouts, LV Distribution Design, Control & Instrumentation Design, Earth Grid Design and General Services Design.
Carrying out Power Systems Electrical Studies: Load Estimates, Protection Coordination, Cable Sizing Calcs. You will have the opportunity to use state-of-the-art engineering software for control and protection design and substation layouts. You will also get to use leading-edge power system modelling software to run steady state and transient electrical studies, including short circuit studies, protection coordination and grid compliance studies for proposed renewable generation
Generating technical documentation and dealing with customers will also be key parts of our graduate programme to help develop your soft skills.
You will also have the opportunity to travel to customer sites to get involved in installation, testing, and commissioning, by participating in design & commissioning of SCADA and control systems in the field.
What about training?
Our induction programme revolves around a 70-20-10 model for learning and development.
70% On-the-job Learning: You'll get stuck in from Day 1, working on real projects, delivering real business value to our customers both on- and off-site.
20% Learning from others: You'll be part of a team, working with subject matter experts and interacting with our customers daily. You'll receive support and guidance, and an invaluable opportunity to learn from former graduates who've seen it and done it.
10% Formal Education: We'll help you become an expert in your chosen field, backed up by formal e-learning and classroom training. This extends to attaining professional certifications where relevant to our business specialisations.

Level 8 Degree in Electrical/ Power Systems/ Energy Engineering, or equivalent.
0-2 years' experience in a similar electrical design role or Work Placement.
Full Irish driving license or to be achieved within 12 months of starting the role.
Desired
Experience in developing Electrical Schematics using AutoCAD, EPLAN or similar.
Experience in developing equipment layouts using AutoCAD, or similar.

We look for candidates who
Work well as part of a team.
Have excellent problem solving and diagnostic skills.
Can complete tasks independently, capable of self-learning.
Can prioritise and coordinate work.
Have excellent customer service, interpersonal, communication and organisational skills.
Can multitask and work well under pressure.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
Enthusiasm for learning within a fast-paced and highly regulated environment.

Opportunities to lead continuous improvement projects.
Cross-functional networking across GSIUC and global Gilead sites.
Development of process engineering, technical leadership, and project management capabilities.

Strong technical knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.
Practical experience in GMP technical services and process support.
Competency in deviation investigations, change management, risk assessment, and validation activities.
Experience supporting technology transfers and new product introductions.

McAvoy & Associates is a consulting firm providing clients with expertise in taxation, business advisory, and accounting services. Founded in 1997, the firm has built a strong reputation for high-quality, partner-led service and a focus on innovative, client-driven solutions.

This is a full-time role based on-site in the heart of Cork city.

Tyndall National Institute is an international leader in semiconductors, photonics and deep-tech research and innovation. As a leading collaborative European research institute, Tyndall is a key actor and hosting partner in the delivery of the ‘Chips for Europe Initiative’ (EU Chips Act).
Tyndall is Ireland’s leading research and innovation organisation and it is the national focal point for excellence in deep-tech research, development and graduate training at the convergence of nanotechnology, microelectronics, photonics, electronics and AI. Tyndall is recognised as an international research leader in semiconductor, chip and digital technologies, particularly as applied to the fields of Information & Communications, Health & Life Sciences, Agritech & Food Security, Energy and Climate Mitigation, emerging fields such as quantum, and novel computing paradigms.
The Institute’s key objective is to see frontier research activities having a significant impact on economic development and societal challenges in Ireland, Europe and beyond. Central to Tyndall’s mission is delivering economic impact through research excellence in partnership with industry and academia. With an annual turnover of more than €50m, the Institute has a community of over 600 researchers, engineers, support staff, postgraduate students, interns and industry researchers-in-residence.
With significant committed Irish government support, Tyndall will grow to be 1,000 people by 2030, with approximately 750 researchers, including 250 PhD students. A new 17,000 m2 research building is under development adjacent to the Cork headquarters and there are developing plans to expand Tyndall’s existing Dublin research labs and to establish other research sites within Ireland.
Tyndall’s expansion is also supported by recent national and EU funding wins for significant (M€10’s) additional research equipment across a range of areas such as semiconductor processing, microscopy, quantum technologies, heterogeneous integration, ultra-high speed optical communications and RF through THz characterisation.
About the Team
You will join a dynamic team of innovation and industry engagement leaders with global experience, who are business partners to Tyndall’s 25 research groups and semiconductor fab facility. The team works closely with each group to advance their emerging technologies in alignment with technology roadmaps and validated industry needs, to establish mutually beneficial industry partnerships with Irish and global partners, and to create scalable startup companies.
You will work closely with other business functions, such as Legal and Finance, and government agency partners, such as IDA and EI, to ensure that our engagement models are best in class and that we establish international partnerships across the EU, US and Asia that deliver economic impact and growth.
About the Role
Tyndall is a partner in three of the Chips JU funded pilot lines, each designed to drive innovation in advanced semiconductor technologies and support European technological sovereignty.
NanoIC Pilot Line - A €1.4bn public investment across 6 partners developing beyond 2nm leading-edge SoC pilot line for advanced logic, memory and interconnect technologies for markets like computing, communication, mobility, energy and health
FAMES Pilot Line – A €0.8bn investment across 11 partners focused on the development of new chip architectures for microcontrollers, microprocessor units, chips for 5G/6G, smart imagers, smart sensors, processors for data fusion, wearable devices, trusted chips, quantum and cryoCMOS, edge AI chip and advanced packaging with chiplets.
PIXEurope Pilot Line - €0.4bn investment across 20 partners advancing next-generation Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) technologies through an open access ecosystem.
As Tyndall’s Pilot Line Business Development Executive, you will play a critical role in catalyzing industry engagement with the pilot line activities in Tyndall. This is a new transformative role, where you will work closely with the EU Pilot Line teams in Tyndall to develop and implement novel industry engagement models to aid the transfer of technology into industry and market deployment. This will include working with pilot line partners across Europe to establish a cohesive network and effective industry engagement platform.
Reporting to Tyndall’s Director of Innovation & Industry Engagement, you will be a member of the Innovation & Industry Engagement Directorate, where you will also support the wider Tyndall Innovation objectives, as detailed in the recently launched Tyndall 2030 strategy. This includes developing and driving collaborative industry partner acquisition, securing industry income, IP commercialisation, and spin-out creation.
Key Duties & Responsibilities
Develop and implement industry engagement strategies and partnership models which underpin Tyndall’s participation in the NanoIC, FAMES, and PIXEurope pilot lines.
Identify, develop, and secure collaborative projects with industry partners by working closely with Pilot Line teams, leading the full contract lifecycle from opportunity development through negotiation and execution.
Secure industry income which contributes to the commercial and strategic objectives of both the pilot lines and Tyndall.
Collaborate with internal departments to achieve successful customer proposals.
Build and expand relationships with semiconductor and semiconductor-enabled companies across Ireland, Europe, and international markets.
Collaborate with Pilot Line teams to clarify partner requirements, align expectations and timelines, and define project scope and deliverables in conjunction with research teams.
Develop strategic programmes, partnerships, and consortia that support the long-term sustainability and growth of the pilot lines and Tyndall beyond the current funding period.
Shape targeted sector and international engagement strategies, working closely with Enterprise Ireland and the IDA to attract new companies and access emerging markets.
Represent Tyndall and its pilot line programmes at national and international conferences, trade shows, and industry events.
Organise, host and represent Tyndall at high-level industry engagements, including executive visits, stakeholder meetings, and strategic events.
Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of prospective customers, partners, and strategic opportunities.
Develop market and commercial intelligence, monitor trends, conduct market research, provide insights and recommendations for implementation.
Prepare regular reports and forecasts against approved objectives, outlining performance, opportunities, customer feedback.
Leadership/mentorship –impart commercial expertise, knowledge, promote a customer focused culture.
Participate in Education and Public Engagement activities.
Ensure compliance with Tyndall’s Quality Management Systems, Health and Safety standards, and other regulations.
Other duties as assigned by the Director of Innovation & Industry Engagement when required.
Essential Criteria
A BSc in engineering or equivalent degree (preferably MSc and or MBA).
Typically 6+ years’ experience in business development, or related activities, in the semiconductor and semiconductor enabled sectors.
Knowledge of the semiconductor value chain and ecosystem sector and trends, including the context of the EU Chips Act and industrial research and development.
Proven track record of successfully negotiating and executing high-value commercial contracts and collaborative agreements.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills, including strong presentation skills.
Highly motivated and adaptable, with the flexibility and willingness to undertake national and international travel.
Record of working independently and also working closely with others to maintain a positive and collaborative environment, in particular during challenging projects.

jobs.title: Maintenance Manager
jobs.desc:
About The Role
Here at Kinisla, we're currently recruiting for a Maintenance Manager to join our Engineering team at the Charleville cheese processing plant, home to the iconic Cheestrings brand. In this role, you will be key to maintaining reliability and efficiency across our 24/7 operation, while driving continuous improvement initiatives. You will lead a skilled team and collaborate closely with colleagues across the business to ensure critical assets perform at their best.
This is a full-time, permanent and onsite position.
What will I be doing?
Lead and develop the maintenance team, fostering a strong people management culture and technical capability
Foster a strong health & safety culture across the team
Drive continuous improvement initiatives and embed Lean principles across maintenance processes
Develop and implement strategies for engineering execution and asset life-cycle management
Introduce and promote knowledge-sharing systems, ensuring active engagement from all team members
Design and deliver training and development plans for the maintenance team
Collaborate with internal stakeholders, external engineering experts, and third-party service providers
Establish and manage Service Level Agreements for plant and utilities maintenance
Ensure robust contingency plans for out-of-hours and critical failures
Oversee permit-to-work processes, including contractor control
Guarantee compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements, particularly regarding hazardous materials
What do I need to be successful?
Degree in Engineering or a relevant trade qualification
Proven experience in a process-driven industry, with practical application of continuous improvement and Lean methodologies (food, pharmaceutical, or medical devices preferred)
Strong leadership, communication and people management skills with a hands-on approach
Good problem-solving ability and engineering mindset
Practical application of engineering principles in operational settings
Solid business acumen and ability to collaborate effectively with manufacturing teams
About Kinisla
Kinisla is a vertically integrated farm-to-fork business with a very substantial consumer foods presence and a leading nutritional and dairy ingredients division, delivering high-quality dairy solutions with a focus on sustainability and innovation. From partnering with local family farms to producing world-class dairy products, we ensure every step of our value chain reflects our commitment to excellence.
With over 50 years' experience in milk processing, dairy and nutritional technology advancement, and product innovation, we are a key stakeholder in the global food industry and creators of a strong portfolio of market leading dairy brands including Cheestrings, Charleville and Coleraine Cheese, Dairygold, Golden Cow and our new SMUG range. Our from food, for food culture and deep-rooted connection to our 2,800 milk suppliers differentiates our business and offers captivating opportunities for our customers and consumers.
Our dairy comes from some of the world's richest grazing land and is produced by a network of Irish family farms that have one of the lowest carbon footprints in the world. Through a combination of expertise, innovation, and sustainability, Kinisla is proud to shape the future of dairy while meeting the diverse needs of our farmers, customers, and communities.
Headquartered in Tralee, Co. Kerry, we operate multiple manufacturing facilities in the southwest of Ireland, including Listowel, Charleville, Newmarket, and Farranfore. Additionally, we manage 28 Farm & Home stores throughout the region, ensuring comprehensive coverage and service. In Northern Ireland and the United Kingdom, our presence extends to key locations in Portadown, Coleraine, and Ossett.
Globally, Kinisla employs over 1,700 dedicated professionals across Ireland, Northern Ireland, the UK, USA, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, and China. In 2024, we achieved a turnover of approximately €1.3 billion, reflecting our commitment to excellence and growth.
Get in touch today!
At Kinisla, we benefit from the knowledge of our colleagues who bring a diverse range of cultures, backgrounds, lifestyles and experiences. One team fostering an inclusive culture that, above all, inspires food and nourishes life. One culture where everyone brings their unique perspectives and experiences to help make us better, together. We are committed to nurturing an environment of positivity and inclusiveness, where everyone can be at their best, both personally and professionally.
Our recruitment, selection and assessment process are based on the skills and competencies of the specific roles and based entirely on merit. We are committed to and value Diversity and Inclusion in all recruitment processes within Kinisla and do not discriminate based on gender, race, class, economic status, ethnic background, sexual orientation, age, political beliefs, veteran status, marital status or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
Principal Industrial Designer - Mouse Design Team : Cork, Ireland
Hybrid role - base 3 days a week on site*
THE ROLE
Logitech is seeking a Principal Industrial Designer to join our Mouse Design Team in Cork. This is a senior-level position for a recognised expert who balances world-class craft with strategic foresight — a thinker and a doer. You will work on complex design assignments, solving unique challenges that have a broad impact on our product portfolio and the future direction of our businesses.
Based in our Cork office, you will be a key member of a team dedicated to excellence in handheld products, leading the creation of mice that are as comfortable, ergonomically superior as they are visually groundbreaking.
WHY IS THIS ROLE IMPORTANT FOR LOGITECH?
The mouse is at the core of Logitech's product portfolio. We design the tools people reach for every day - products where form, material, ergonomics, and engineering precision must coexist seamlessly and where world class design quality is non-negotiable. At the Principal level, you will be shaping the future of one of our most competitive and scrutinised product categories. We prototype to learn, design to inspire, and ship real products that people enthuse about and love to use.
YOUR CONTRIBUTION
Move fast. Speak up. Decide and own. Drive change.
Visionary Craft & Innovation: Lead the design and development of future-forward mouse experiences, transforming complex human problems into polished, intuitive, and beautiful design solutions.
Strategic Influence: Partner with senior leadership to shape the long-term direction of the Mouse Design Team, ensuring design strategy aligns with emerging trends and business objectives.
Design Excellence: Manage key design processes and projects from brief through to production builds, maintaining an unrelenting focus on quality, detail, and creative confidence.
Mentorship & Leadership: Provide guidance and thought leadership to the broader design team. Mentor other designers and foster a culture of curiosity and exceptional craftsmanship.
Collaborative Networking: Build strong relationships with engineering, product marketing, and business stakeholders to drive design quality and change across a multidisciplinary environment.
Key Qualifications
To be considered, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviours to our team:
Proven Track Record: 10+ years of relevant experience in Industrial Design, either in-house or at a leading agency, with a portfolio of successful, high-volume consumer hardware products.
Physical-Digital Mastery: Exceptional hands-on skills in sketching, visualisation, and physical prototyping (including hand-sculpting in foam). Deep understanding of anthropometrics, ergonomics, and the iterative digital-to-physical workflow required for handheld devices.
3D CAD Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in surface CAD - excellent working knowledge of Rhino, SolidWorks, Alias, Fusion or Creo Parametric, Class-A surfacing principles and experience exchanging high-quality 3D files with mechanical engineers and CAD specialists.
CMF & Manufacturing: Working expertise in Materials, Colours and Finishes, Design for Manufacturing, and EVT/DVT/PVT build processes — you understand how to maintain design intent through engineering development.
AI Proficiency: Comfortable integrating AI tools (e.g., Vizcom, Gemini, Magnific) into ideation and concept visualisation workflows. Able to move faster and explore more broadly because of it - not instead of core craft.
Communication & Storytelling: Able to craft compelling design narratives and present persuasively to stakeholders at all levels, from engineers to senior executives.
Highly driven, collaborative, and a proactive self-starter — you take on ambiguous assignments and drive them through to valuable outcomes.
Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Industrial Design, Product Design, or a related field.
OUR CULTURE
At Logitech, we act like a small company. We believe that anyone can have the best idea. We value designers who are humble, hungry, and brave enough to challenge conventional thinking — and we offer a highly collaborative, international environment where your work will impact millions of people worldwide.
Logitech is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Logitech are considered without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. Drive consistency in System Platform configuration, deployment models and integration approaches across sites.

Strong hands-on experience with: AVEVA System Platform
AVEVA OMI
AVEVA InTouch
AVEVA InBatch
AVEVA MES integrations
Experience using SQL within industrial environments for data management and troubleshooting.

Strong stakeholder engagement, documentation and communication skills.
Degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
Typically 5 to 10 years’ experience in industrial automation or OT roles.

Experience supporting global digital transformation programmes.
Exposure to standardisation of plant models, templates and multi-site architectures.
Familiarity with lifecycle management and sustainment of OT platforms at scale.

Job Description
Engineer the Future of Water. Empower Communities. Protect the Planet.
At Mott MacDonald, we’re not just building infrastructure we’re shaping the systems that deliver clean water, protect public health, and support sustainable living. As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer in our Water Division, you’ll be part of a team that’s transforming the entire water cycle from abstraction and treatment to distribution and disposal.
You’ll work on high-profile, innovative projects, including advanced resilience schemes at some of the largest wastewater treatment works in the UK, helping protect the River Thames and surrounding communities from pollution and flooding. This is your opportunity to contribute to meaningful change, supported by a culture that values your growth, wellbeing, and ideas.
What You’ll Be Doing
Design with purpose: Contribute to mechanical designs across the full water cycle potable water systems, wastewater treatment, and more.
Innovate and collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to deliver sustainable, forward-thinking solutions for complex challenges.
Learn and grow: Gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies and engineering practices, supported by mentoring and training.
Make an impact: Help deliver projects that improve lives, protect ecosystems, and respond to the climate emergency.
Candidate Specification
At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.
To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience
(excluding placements
) and have a masters degree (obtained no earlier than 2025) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines:
Mechanical Engineering
In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests - such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.
We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.

reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com

A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.
It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.
Agile working
At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust.
Equality, diversity, and inclusion

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - AI Platform and Enablement

Role Overview
This is a hybrid role based in our Cork office.
As a Staff Engineer on NETGEAR’s AI Platform and Enablement team, you will play a strategic and highly impactful role in shaping how AI is built into the fabric of the whole company: engineering teams, business units and corporate functions alike. This position is designed for a deeply experienced technical leader who thrives at the intersection of AI infrastructure, developer enablement and business enablement.
You will own three interconnected areas of ownership. First, you will help build and operate the core AI and LLM platform: model routing, evaluation, and the shared tooling that lets teams across NETGEAR build reliably on top of large language models. Second, you will scale the use of coding agents and assistants across engineering, raising AI fluency and the bar on how we ship software. Third, and equally important, you will extend AI enablement beyond engineering and into business functions — finding the workflows worth automating and building them.
That third mandate is not a side project. A meaningful share of NETGEAR’s near-term AI value sits in business process, not product code, and this role is expected to have organisation-wide impact. Much of the work will resemble the enablement currently being driven for non-technical teams, scaled up and made repeatable.
With significant autonomy, you will own delivery of key technical initiatives aligned with organisational goals and directly influence the short and medium-term success of NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
Key Responsibilities
AI and LLM Platform Infrastructure
Design, build, and operate the shared AI platform layer: model routing and fallback strategies, API gateway patterns, rate limiting, and multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic, OpenAI, and others as needed).
Own cost and usage optimisation across the organisation’s AI spend, covering model selection, prompt and context efficiency, caching, and session-level cost controls.
Build evaluation, observability, and monitoring for LLM-powered features and agents, including quality regression detection and usage analytics.
Define architecture and standards for secure, scalable integration of AI capabilities into product and internal systems, including authentication, data handling, and compliance considerations.
Engineering AI Enablement
Drive adoption and effective use of AI coding agents and assistants (for example Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) across engineering teams.
Build internal tooling, guardrails, and workflows (agentic SDLC patterns, managed agents, review and QA processes) that let engineers safely delegate more work to AI.
Establish best practices, documentation, and training that raise the AI fluency of the wider engineering organisation.
Business and Functional Enablement
Partner directly with business units and corporate functions (Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, Sales, People, Legal) to identify high-value AI opportunities in their day-to-day work.
Sit with functional teams, map how their processes actually run today, and simplify before automating: strip out steps that exist only for historical reasons rather than encoding them into an agent.
Design and deliver AI solutions for non-technical users, including skills, agents, connectors and internal applications that people without an engineering background can adopt and trust.
Build the enablement layer that makes this repeatable: reusable patterns, templates, onboarding material, office hours, and a community of practice across functions.
Translate fluently in both directions - turning business problems into technical designs and explaining technical constraints and risks in language a functional leader can act on.
Technical Leadership and Collaboration
Reporting directly to the AI Platform Engineering Director, working with cross-functional teams to align technical execution with NETGEAR’s AI strategy.
Own delivery of end-to-end initiatives that bridge platform infrastructure, developer tooling, business process and product engineering.
Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and system debugging across multiple layers of the platform.
Provide mentorship and guidance to engineers and functional champions working with AI tools and platform services, nurturing a culture of technical excellence and responsible AI use.
Establish and track clear objectives, delivering measurable results aligned with quarterly goals and reporting on AI-driven productivity gains and cost efficiency across the organisation.
Required Qualifications
8+ years of software engineering experience, with a demonstrated history of leading impactful technical initiatives.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or similar) in production, including prompt and context design, tool use, and agentic workflows.
Demonstrated ability to simplify complexity: taking a tangled business flow or legacy process, understanding it end to end, and reducing it to something clear, reliable and automatable. A track record of continuously exploring new tools and techniques in a fast-moving field.
Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to deliver technology that they adopt and keep using.
Strong track record of cost, performance, and reliability optimisation in cloud or distributed systems, with a proven ability to influence business outcomes through technology decisions.
Experience building or operating internal developer platforms, APIs, or shared infrastructure used by multiple teams.
Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools and a genuine interest in scaling their use across an organisation.
Strong design and architectural skills, including experience with distributed systems, observability, and secure API design.
Proficiency in one or more of: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or similar languages used for platform and tooling development.
Demonstrated experience defining and delivering on a platform or enablement strategy, not just individual features.
Strong communicator, able to articulate technical direction to both technical and non-technical audiences and comfortable presenting to functional leadership.
Experience with agent frameworks, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or similar tool-orchestration approaches.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent hands-on experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Background in business process automation, RPA, workflow tooling or systems integration across enterprise applications (for example ERP, CRM, finance or supply chain systems).
Expertise with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automation (for example GitHub Actions) applied to AI and ML workflows.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native architectures.
Background in data or ML engineering, evaluation frameworks, or LLMOps.
Experience working across mobile, web, or embedded systems and understanding how AI integrates with each.

jobs.title: Project Engineer / Continuous Improvement Engineer
jobs.desc:
About the Role:
Join us at Ferrero Cork as a RDM (Project Engineer / Continuous Improvement Engineer), where you will take ownership of leading site performance improvement, maintenance excellence, asset optimization, and strategic operational initiatives. Working closely with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and external partners, you will lead initiatives that enhance safety, quality, productivity, asset performance, and cost competitiveness. The RDM will play a critical role in improving plant performance by driving reliability, operational efficiency, continuous improvement, and capital project delivery across the site.
This role is responsible for developing and executing improvement strategies, leading cross functional projects, optimizing maintenance systems and processes, supporting capital investments, and delivering measurable business results. Acting as a key partner to operational teams, you will ensure sustainable improvements and long term value creation across the facility.
Main Responsibilities:
At the Core of the RDM role lies Asset Performance & Maintenance Excellence. A key part of your role will be to develop and implement strategies to improve equipment performance, uptime, and overall plant efficiency while driving maintenance excellence through the optimization of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities. You will lead initiatives aimed at improving OEE, reducing downtime, and eliminating recurring equipment failures. The RDM is responsible for monitoring and analysing maintenance and operational KPIs to identify opportunities for improvement while supporting maintenance planning and scheduling processes to maximise resource utilisation and asset availability. Ensuring maintenance activities are aligned with business objectives, safety standards, and operational requirements you will promote best practices in asset management, maintenance systems, and equipment lifecycle management.
A key part of this role is Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence. You will lead continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety, quality, productivity, reliability, and cost performance while facilitating structured problem solving and root cause analysis activities to address operational challenges. You will drive TPM, Lean Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, and loss elimination programs across the site, analysing operational data and trends to identify improvement opportunities and optimise processes. Developing and implementing sustainable corrective and preventive actions will form a key part of your remit. You will support business case development and ROI evaluations for improvement projects. You will champion a culture of continuous improvement and accountability across all departments.
Projects & Capital Investment will sit at the heart of your role. You will lead and coordinate operational and technical projects from concept through execution and completion while developing project plans, budgets, timelines, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies. Managing capital projects, equipment upgrades, installations, and process improvement initiatives, you will coordinate cross functional teams to ensure successful project delivery. You will monitor project performance to ensure objectives are achieved within scope, budget, and schedule while supporting equipment commissioning, validation, and handover activities. In addition, you’ll ensure all projects deliver measurable business benefits and sustainable operational improvements.
You will play an integral part in Stakeholder & Contractor Management, building strong working relationships with internal stakeholders across all site functions. Coordinating contractors, suppliers, service providers, and engineering partners, you will develop project scopes and support contractor selection and procurement activities. This role is responsible for monitoring contractor performance and ensuring deliverables meet agreed expectations, while ensuring contractors comply with site safety, quality, GMP, and operational standards. In addition, you will provide regular updates on project progress, risks, and performance to site leadership.
As the RDM you will take ownership of Governance, Compliance & Reporting. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate records relating to maintenance, projects, asset performance, and improvement activities, while ensuring compliance with company standards, GMP requirements, food safety systems, environmental regulations, and health and safety legislation. You will support internal and external audits, inspections, and compliance programs. Finally, this role is responsible for the development and maintenance of performance dashboards and reports to support data driven decision making while contributing to the development and standardisation of maintenance, project management, and operational excellence processes.
About You:
You will bring a relevant 3rd level qualification in Engineering, Manufacturing, Maintenance, Operations Management, or Food Science. Experience within a manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, or operational environment would be highly advantageous, as would experience delivering operational improvements and business performance results while leading cross functional teams and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
The ideal candidate will have experience in project management, capital expenditure projects, and technical improvement initiatives and is self motivated with a strong focus on execution, accountability, and results. Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and asset management principles are key.

This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
Job Position Overview
The Global Manufacturing and Quality Learning & Development (GMQLD) team is dedicated to delivering learning solutions that empower Lilly's Manufacturing and Quality organizations to achieve our mission: making medicine with safety first and quality always. The Learning Architect (LA) is a platform-specific learning professional responsible for designing and maintaining training that serve an entire manufacturing platform. Located at Kinsale, IN Manufacturing site, the LA addresses 90% platform-level and 10% site-level content needs, designing within COE standards and governance frameworks.
Responsibilities
The LA is accountable for platform-specific curriculum design, development, and maintenance within the GMQLD operating model. The LA partners with site SMEs, Platform Leads, and the COE to ensure training content is current, compliant, and aligned to manufacturing process needs.
Platform Curriculum Design & Development
Design and develop platform-specific training content within COE governance frameworks and global standards.
Address 90% platform-level content and 10% site-specific needs, as assigned by the M2/P4 Platform Lead.
Partner with site Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) on curriculum development, ensuring content reflects current manufacturing processes.
Apply process-based curricula principles — organize content by manufacturing process with task-level qualification.
Ensure curriculum aligns to the three-layer content model (Global / Platform / Site).
Content Governance & Quality
Design content within COE standards, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements.
Feed content gaps and site needs up to Platform Lead and COE for resolution.
Pull global content from COE as foundation for platform-specific curriculum.
Support learning equivalency, exception and substitution decisions in alignment with the Quality system.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership
Partner with Platform Lead (M2/P4) on L&D strategy and business priorities across platform site
Interface with COE for standards, governance, and cross-platform alignment.
Collaborate with LEPs to understand site-specific execution needs and inform curriculum updates.
Represent the platform in cross-functional forums, audits, and governance reviews.
Continuous Improvement
Support Time to Qualification optimization initiatives by identifying training burden, content redundancy, and qualification bottlenecks.
Contribute to OJT standardization across platform sites.
Use data to identify improvement opportunities in curriculum effectiveness and qualification outcomes.
Basic Qualifications
Education Level: Bachelor's degree, OR a minimum of 10 years of equivalent relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
Experience:
5+ years' experience in a GxP-regulated environment.
Area or functional specific expertise in Learning & Development, instructional design, or Manufacturing/Quality operations.
Experience with curriculum design, learning management systems, and GMP training requirements.
Strong understanding of GxP and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), regulatory requirements, and compliance training.
Certifications: N/A
Licenses: N/A
Language Requirements: English proficiency (written & verbal)
Required Skills Testing: N/A
Additional Skills/ Preferences
Deep knowledge of platform-specific manufacturing processes (e.g., PFS, Cartridge, DAP/EM, Chemical, Biologics).
Experience with process-based or competency-based curriculum architecture.
Ability to work across multiple sites and time zones.
Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams (Quality, Operations, Engineering).
Experience with digital learning tools, DOJT, or OJT standardization.
Familiarity with Workday, SuccessFactors, or equivalent HR/learning systems.
Additional Information
Position Location: Site-Based in Kinsale, Ireland
Travel Percentage (%): 10%
Shift Information: Site-based at Kinsale platform manufacturing site. Not remote. Preferred locations are guidelines — the LA serves the entire platform (90% platform-level work).

Our client is a leading provider of pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical and cleanroom equipment solutions, supporting some of the most advanced life sciences manufacturing facilities across Ireland and the UK.
