jobs.title: Principal Design Engineer
jobs.desc:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality.
Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.
Job Title: Principal Digital Design Engineer
Location: Munich, Cork, Katowice, Edinburgh
Reports to:
Senior Principal Engineer
The Role
We are seeking an exceptional Principal Digital Design Engineer to join the Performance Solutions Group (PSG).
The candidate will contribute to the development of complex, high-performance semiconductor designs.
You will work as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team, developing and integrating RTL for advanced SoCs and silicon platforms. You will be involved throughout the front-end design process, from understanding architectural requirements and developing microarchitectures through RTL implementation, simulation, synthesis, and handoff to downstream teams.
This is a hands-on engineering role suited to someone who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, learning new technologies, and working across the boundaries between architecture, RTL, verification, and physical implementation.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and integrate high-quality synthesizable RTL using SystemVerilog.
Translate architectural specifications into robust, efficient microarchitectures and RTL implementations.
Work with architects and senior engineers to understand functional and performance requirements.
Develop RTL that meets requirements for performance, power, area, and functionality.
Participate in RTL design reviews and contribute to design methodology and coding standards.
Develop and maintain unit-level and block-level test environments in collaboration with verification engineers.
Debug functional issues using simulation, waveform analysis, assertions, and other verification tools.
Work with verification teams to identify, reproduce, and resolve RTL design issues.
Collaborate with physical design engineers to understand and address timing, area, power, and implementation constraints.
Support synthesis, timing analysis, linting, CDC analysis, and other front-end quality checks.
Contribute to integration of internally developed and third-party IP.
Help investigate and resolve issues encountered during integration and downstream implementation.
Document design decisions, interfaces, microarchitecture, implementation details and reviews within the PSG Quality Management System (QMS)
Contribute to continuous improvement of RTL methodologies, automation, and development flows.
Work alongside senior engineers to develop solutions to challenging customer and internal silicon problems.
Technical Scope
Depending On Experience, The Role May Encompass Areas Including
SystemVerilog RTL
SoC and subsystem design
CPU, GPU, AI/ML, networking, or other high-performance compute architectures
Control logic and datapaths
Memory interfaces and controllers
High-speed interfaces
Clock and reset architectures
AMBA protocols such as AXI, AHB, and APB
IP integration
Low-power design techniques
Assertions and formal verification
RTL synthesis and optimization
Static analysis, lint, and CDC
Performance and power optimization
RTL-to-gates implementation flows
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of relevant RTL/ASIC design experience.
Proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog.
Understanding of digital logic design and synchronous design principles.
Experience developing synthesizable RTL for ASIC or FPGA implementations.
Familiarity with simulation and RTL debugging.
Understanding of common SoC interfaces and protocols.
Basic understanding of synthesis, timing, and physical implementation considerations.
Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
Ability to communicate effectively to customers
What Success Looks Like
Deliver robust RTL. Develop clean, maintainable, synthesizable RTL that meets functional and performance requirements.
Think beyond the RTL. Understand how design decisions affect verification, synthesis, timing, power, area, and ultimately silicon.
Solve problems independently. Take ownership of assigned blocks and issues while knowing when to seek guidance from more senior engineers.
Work collaboratively. Build strong working relationships with architects, verification, physical design, and other Silicon Engineering teams.
Learn quickly. Develop expertise in new architectures, technologies, methodologies, and Cadence tools as projects evolve.
Grow into technical leadership. Develop the depth and breadth needed to take ownership of increasingly complex blocks and eventually lead technical areas within the Silicon Engineering organisation.
Why Join the PSG Team?
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced semiconductor technology, EDA, and real silicon.
You will work on problems that are often at the limits of what current design methodologies and technologies can achieve, collaborating with some of the world's leading semiconductor companies and technology partners.
Rather than being limited to a single product or stage of the design flow, you will have the opportunity to influence the entire path from technology and methodology through to working silicon.
If you are an engineer who wants to solve the industry's hardest silicon problems—and see those solutions become real products—this is the team for you.
Additional Information
Cadence is committed to equal employment opportunity and employment equity throughout all levels of the organization. We strive to attract a qualified and diverse candidate pool and encourage diversity and inclusion in the workplace.
Travel:
<10%
We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.

jobs.title: Senior Change Manager
jobs.desc:
Barden is delighted to partner with a European business headquartered in Cork as they appoint a Senior Change Manager on a 12 month daily rate contract, to lead organisational change across a major transformation programme.
Six workstreams are live: a new ERP, project and portfolio management tooling, process redesign, governance and reporting, AI adoption, and a new data platform. The technology is being built. The change discipline that needs to sit alongside it does not exist yet.
Building it is the first half of this role. Landing it across workstreams that are already moving is the second.
You will report directly to the Head of PMO, own the change agenda for the entire programme, and work across several European countries — each with its own history and its own appetite for change. Executive sponsorship and board approval are already in place.
"We've said out loud that we haven't been doing change well, and there's no framework here yet. We're not looking for someone to run ours — we're looking for someone to build it."
– Head of PMO
WHY THIS ROLE
You build it rather than inherit it. Nothing exists today, and there is real appetite at the top for someone to own it.
Change across the whole programme, not one slice of one workstream.
A business that has already told its own people it needs to do change better. You will not spend six months proving the problem exists.
Six concurrent workstreams spanning systems, process, data, and AI, with exposure across the executive team.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Build the change approach from scratch: framework, standards, templates, governance, and decision rights.
Own the portfolio change roadmap across all six workstreams.
Hold the change saturation view, with the mandate to tell project managers and the executive team when something has to move.
Run impact and readiness assessments, stakeholder engagement, communications, and adoption planning across concurrent workstreams.
Lead the change champion network and build capability through coaching and communities of practice.
Equip sponsors, and address resistance across multiple countries rather than working around it.
Define outcome-based measures, build portfolio reporting, and feed lessons learned back into governance.
ABOUT THE PERSON
Has built or substantially tailored a change approach, not just operated one someone else designed.
Led change across concurrent programmes with competing priorities.
Landed large system and process change, and the adoption that has to follow it.
Worked across cultures and geographies, with real evidence of navigating resistance.
Has the credibility, and the personality, to hold a straight conversation with an executive team.
Prosci, APMG, or CCMP welcome, as are PRINCE2, PMI, MSP, or Agile. What you have delivered matters more here than what you are certified in.
OTHER DETAILS
12 month daily rate contract.
Cork-based, two days per week on site.
Occasional European travel.
Reporting directly to the Head of PMO.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, supervise and coordinate bricklaying operatives and subcontractors to ensure works are completed safely, efficiently and in line with project programmes.
Plan daily and weekly activities, allocating labour, materials and equipment to maximise productivity and meet construction milestones.
Review drawings, specifications and construction details to ensure masonry works are delivered in accordance with design requirements.
Monitor workmanship standards and carry out regular quality inspections to ensure all brickwork, blockwork and masonry installations meet company and client expectations.
Coordinate material deliveries, storage and usage on site, minimising waste and ensuring sufficient resources are available to maintain progress.
Liaise closely with Site Managers, Engineers, Quantity Surveyors and other trade supervisors to coordinate works and resolve site issues.

This is a role for an experienced engineering professional who understands how complex designs move from development into delivery. You will coordinate technical interfaces, manage design information and help project teams resolve issues before they affect construction, programme or cost.

Practical experience coordinating multidisciplinary BIM models and managing coordination issues through to resolution.

Strong communication and organisational skills, with the ability to facilitate coordination activities and engage effectively with multidisciplinary project teams.

Experience using Autodesk Revit on infrastructure projects

Knowledge of Bentley iTwin for multidisciplinary model federation, design review and project coordination.
Experience contributing to BIM Execution Plans, responsibility matrices, MIDPs, TIDPs and related information management documentation.
Experience facilitating BIM coordination reviews or meetings and maintaining issue and action registers.
Awareness of BIM-related project risks, capability assessments, mobilisation activities and information delivery reporting.
Experience supporting, mentoring or training colleagues in BIM authoring tools, coordination processes, CDE workflows and project standards.

Description
Diversity matters
We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.
We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!
Who we are
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.
The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the Ireland. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.
The role
In this role, you’ll be the face of the store, welcoming customers and providing a fun, engaging shopping experience. You’ll use your product knowledge to offer personalised recommendations, perform product demonstrations, and hand out tailored samples. Working closely with your team, you’ll help drive sales, exceed targets, and create memorable in-store events that keep customers coming back. You'll also manage stock, ensure the shop floor looks its best, and adapt displays to seasonal trends. With flexible shifts, a competitive hourly rate based on the Living Wage, and opportunities for bonuses, you’ll be well-supported through training and development to grow your skills.
Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.

8+hours per week
hours can increase with availability/footfall

full
availability on Monday, Thursday and weekends for this role. We expect to run another recruitment drive next month for other availabilities.

Greet customers warmly and create a welcoming store environment.
Engage with customers to understand their needs, provide personalized recommendations, and offer product demonstrations.

Maintain a clean, tidy, and visually appealing shop floor.

jobs.title: Christmas Customer Assistant
jobs.desc:
Please note, this role is located in IRELAND
Ready to make someone's day this Christmas? Join Boots as a Seasonal Customer Assistant and be part of something special.
The festive season at Boots is one of the busiest and most exciting times of the year, and we're looking for enthusiastic people to help create brilliant experiences for our customers when it matters most.
About The Opportunity
As a Seasonal Customer Assistant, you'll be at the heart of the action, helping customers find the perfect gift, discover great offers and get what they need for the celebrations ahead.
You'll be the friendly face customers turn to for advice and support, creating feel-good moments that make a real difference and keep them coming back all year round.
This is an important role where you'll help deliver a great experience for our customers. It's also a fast-paced and active role where priorities can change quickly throughout the day.
You won't just be helping customers on the shop floor. You'll also support deliveries, replenish stock, and help keep the store looking its best.
Working in store is a real team effort, so you'll need to be flexible and ready to step into different areas to keep things running smoothly. You'll feel good knowing you're playing your part and enjoy a strong sense of teamwork and fun as everyone pulls together during our busiest season.
If you enjoy helping people, staying busy and being part of a supportive team, this could be the role for you.
This is a temporary role, with the potential for longer-term opportunities depending on local availability.
You Will
What you'll be doing
Welcome customers, understand their needs and help them find the right products, gifts, services and offers.
Create memorable customer experiences through friendly, personalised service.
Help customers complete purchases using tills and self-checkouts.
Replenish stock and keep shelves full
Support deliveries and help organise stock in the stockroom.
Keep the store and shopping areas look their best.
Work across different areas of the store and support your team wherever help is needed.
What You'll Need To Have (our Must-haves)
Available to work Bank Holidays including Black Friday week and weekend, Cyber Monday, Christmas Eve, St Stephen's Day and New Year's Day.
Customer-focused — enjoys talking to people and helping customers have a great experience.
Team player — supports others and cares about team success.
Operations ready — comfortable balancing customer service with stock, fulfilment and shop floor tasks.
Proactive attitude — sees what needs doing and takes ownership.
Resilient — stays positive and focused during busy periods.
Energy and stamina — keeps energy high throughout long, active shifts.
Confident asking questions — asks for help when needed to get things right.
Comfortable with technology — learns new systems and confidently uses handheld devices, tills and self-checkouts.
It would be great if you also have
Previous experience in a retail or customer-facing environment.
Familiarity with Boots products and services.
Where your brilliance can take you
You’ll receive industry-recognised training and build valuable experience along the way. You may go on to explore more in Retail, Pharmacy, Beauty or Opticians, or ultimately progress into management. There are plenty of paths to follow for you to become brilliant with Boots —you can read some of our
colleagues stories here.
Rewards designed for you
Discretionary Christmas bonus
Generous employee discount (After 1 month’s service)
Access to our One Hub discount platform
There’s lots more in our benefits and discounts, MyBoosts – there to give you that little lift in your everyday. Find out more at
boots.jobs/ireland
Exclusions may apply; eligible roles only. Please note that any salary estimates provided on third-party sites are not endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate.
A Bit About Us
At Boots, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, creating a place where everyone feels welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. We believe that when our people feel valued and included, they thrive, so we're committed to creating a brilliant Boots for our people so they can make a difference for our customers and colleagues every time.
What’s next?
If you apply, our team will be in touch to let you know the outcome of your application or to arrange next steps. Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options.
If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you be at your best.
We hope to hear from you soon.
Be brilliant with Boots.

We are looking for a Audit Junior to join us who is comfortable in an evolving environment and enjoys solving a variety of challenges that contribute to meaningful outcomes.
Our graduate scheme is designed for you to put your academic knowledge into practice and become a crucial asset for our clients. From day one, you will be making an impact. We work a diverse range of sectors including fashion, leisure, hospitality, renewable energy, gaming, and motorsports. This exposure will provide you with a broad perspective and varied experiences that will enrich your professional journey.
What does a career in Audit actually involve?
Audit is a varied and highly client-facing career that gives you the opportunity to work with a wide range of organisations and understand how their businesses operate. You’ll spend time working at MHA offices as well as regularly travelling to and working from client sites, so you’ll need to be comfortable working in different environments, meeting new people and representing MHA professionally. As some client locations may be more difficult to reach by public transport, being able to travel independently and having access to a car can be beneficial for this role. From an early stage, you’ll build relationships with clients, ask questions and gather the information and evidence you need to support your work, while collaborating closely with colleagues across the audit team. You’ll develop your understanding of financial information and business processes, carry out testing and analytical work, and use your curiosity and professional judgement to explore anything that requires further attention. If you enjoy meeting new people, asking questions, understanding how businesses work and the variety of working with different clients and in different locations, Audit could be a great fit for you.
As an Audit Junior, you’ll experience the power of collaboration as you work with diverse teams on real projects, building lasting connections with colleagues and start off by learning the fundamentals, including:
Working on audit and accounts preparation assignments with your team,
Working closely with your mentor on audit planning memorandum,
Analytical reviews,
Drafting client letters,
Preparing accounts and producing sets of financial statements.
Studying towards Professional Qualification (CAI)
Rewards That Resonate

Hands-On Experience: Dive into practical, on-the-job training and build valuable client relationships early on.
Career Growth: We are globally united through Baker Tilly International, providing you with access to both our national and an extensive global network. There are opportunities for secondments, and you will gain experience with a diverse range of clients, from pioneering entrepreneurs to international business groups.
A Supportive Network: Join a vibrant, social community where mentors and peers are dedicated to your success and personal development.
Are You Ready to Elevate Your Career?
Apply now and be part of a team that celebrates diversity, champions innovation, and prioritises your success.
At Baker Tilly Ireland, we know that diversity, inclusion, and belonging lead to better decisions, stronger performance, and a workplace where everyone can feel included and thrive. That’s why we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences.
Disability Confident

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process to help you perform at your best, please let us know and we will be happy to help.

jobs.desc:
Company
QT Technologies Ireland Limited
Job Area
Interns Group, Interns Group > Interim Intern
General Summary
About The Role
The Snapdragon Engineering team in Cork, Ireland is seeking interns for our CPU teams focusing on Advanced gen CPU Micro Architecture RTL Design , CPU Design verifications and Post-Silicon CPU cores Power and Performance.
The Cork site is home to a range of digital and embedded Software teams working on cutting edge IP for the latest Snapdragon chipsets, working with the latest toolsets and flows on bleeding edge FinFET/GAA silicon nodes in 3nm and below.
Team members work directly with architecture, software, measurement and SoC teams in Ireland and other global Qualcomm locations. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to experience how leading-edge ASICs and SoCs in advanced CMOS processes for multi-function mobile platforms are developed and will develop a wide array of skills relevant to a future career in this exciting industry.
Minimum Qualifications
Relevant skills include experience/courses with one or more of the following:
Strong Interpersonal, communications and teamwork skills required
Strong Computer Architecture, Digital Design, Coding and Scripting: Verilog, C/C++, Python, Tcl/Perl/shell-scripting.
Verification Methodology using System Verilog.
Knowledge of Low Power Design.
Knowledge of ARM processors or RISC-V processors architecture, Power, Performance and Industry Benchmarks.
Excellent computer skills (Including, but not limited to: Windows, Office, Visio).
Dedication to successful and thorough completion of assigned tasks.
Preferred Qualifications
Enrolled in a bachelor or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering.

Experience with large backend/compiled codebases and performance-sensitive software, preferably in Rust

Strong systems fundamentals, including multi-threaded programming and performance profiling. Bonus points for:
Understanding of network protocols, TLS, and connection lifecycle management.
Familiarity with security concepts such as attack surface reduction, input validation, memory safety, and defense-in-depth architectures.
Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills for communicating to a wide variety of audiences ranging from junior engineers to executive stakeholder

Passion for learning new things in the domains of computer science and software engineering

Define and drive the technical strategy for Ingress Security, in collaboration with stakeholders across Server, Atlas, SRE, and Product Security
Own the definition, planning, and execution of technical plans to deliver solutions to ambiguous, high-impact security and networking problems
Design, implement, and operate production-ready security services in Rust, with a focus on security, correctness, performance, and operational excellence
Collaborate with Engineering leadership and other Product & Technology teams on roadmaps to improve the security posture of MongoDB's ingress stack
Advise across the team and organization on engineering complexity, risk, and inter-project dependencies

Diagnose test failures, identify bugs, performance regressions, and other defects in existing code, and fix them
Interview candidates for software engineering positions, and work with Engineering leadership to cultivate the team's talent bench for long-term growth and success

Staff Mixed Signal Design Engineer
About The Role
As a Staff Mixed Signal Design Engineer, you will provide technical leadership in the design and development of sophisticated mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs) including power management ICs, ADCs, DACs, PLLs, and other mixed-signal blocks. You'll make critical architectural decisions, drive technical innovation, and establish mixed-signal design methodologies.
Your expertise will bridge both analog and digital domains, enabling you to optimize system performance while mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance semiconductor solutions.
Job Duties And Responsibilities
As a Staff Mixed-Signal Design Engineer within the Advanced Cores Group (ACG) you will work on the development of ADC, DAC, and/or SerDes PHY subsystems for highly sophisticated mixed-signal system-on-chip (SoC) integrated circuit products using FinFET wafer technologies. The Advanced Cores Group develops innovative, state of the art, high-performance circuits as often shown by presentations at premier conferences and publications in premier journals. Your work will include:
Evaluating alternative mixed-signal subsystem implementation architectures.
Designing challenging transistor-level mixed-signal integrated circuits.
Preparing effective design documents and conduct effective design reviews.
Guiding mixed-signal integrated circuit layout.
Guiding mixed-signal integrated circuit evaluation and test.
Qualifications
MS Electrical Engineering.
7+ years of mixed-signal integrated circuit development experience.
Strong understanding of data converter architectures and specifications and/or deep understanding of SerDes PHY architectures and specifications
Deep understanding of mixed-signal design fundamentals, design tools, and methodologies.
Solid understanding of integrated circuit product development, including design, verification, evaluation, test, and qualification.
Successful experience developing challenging mixed-signal integrated circuits for commercial applications.
Strong technical leadership, teamwork, and communication skills.
Why You’ll Love Working at ADI
At Analog Devices, you'll be part of a collaborative and innovative team that's shaping the future of technology. We offer a supportive environment focused on professional growth, competitive compensation and benefits, work-life balance, and the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects that make a real impact on the world.
Your expertise will shape the future of technology, and you’ll be supported by a culture that values continuous advancement and professional growth. Join us and help create the technologies that bridge the physical and digital worlds, making a tangible difference in how people live, work, and connect.

As a Sport Advisor (Sales Assistant), you are the face of our store and the primary connection to our customers. By providing expert advice to everyone from beginners to seasoned athletes, you ensure they leave with the right gear, the right service, and a great experience—whether in-store, online, or beyond.
What You'll Do:
Deliver exceptional customer experiences by providing tailored product and service solutions:
Provide Excellent Customer Service: Connect with customers across all channels (in-store, online, social media) to understand their needs and guide them towards the best solutions for their sporting activities.
Offer a Range of Solutions: Present various products and services that meet diverse needs and budgets, including new items, used gear, rentals, and subscriptions.
Build Relationships: Cultivate positive relationships with customers to foster loyalty and encourage them to return for future purchases.
Promote Products and Services: Actively promote and sell our offer through various channels, including in-store interactions, online platforms, and social media engagement.

Create a welcoming and accessible store environment that encourages customers to explore our diverse range of sports products and solutions:
Create a Welcoming Environment: Design and maintain customer-friendly store layouts that are accessible, safe, and encourage exploration of our sports products and solutions.
Facilitate Informed Choices: Ensure clear and accessible product information to help customers make informed decisions about their purchases.
Guarantee Product Availability: Maintain accurate stock levels and ensure both physical and digital availability of products to meet customer demand.
Prioritise Customer Safety: Maintain a safe store environment and protect customer data in line with the company’s guidelines.
Showcase Product Range: Develop visually appealing and effective product displays that highlight the breadth of our offerings and inspire customers.
Promote Sustainability: Support our commitment to sustainability through responsible waste management and promoting eco-friendly products and practices.
Who You Are:
We're looking for passionate individuals who are excited to join our team and contribute to our mission of moving people through the wonders of sport. You are:
A Sports Enthusiast: You have a genuine passion for sports and enjoy sharing your knowledge and enthusiasm with others.
Customer-Focused: You're dedicated to providing exceptional customer service and building positive relationships with every individual.
A Collaborative Teammate: You thrive in a team environment, value collaboration and cooperation, and contribute to a positive and supportive atmosphere.
An Effective Communicator: You possess strong interpersonal and communication skills, enabling you to connect with customers and colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
A Problem-Solver: You're resourceful, adaptable, and able to think critically to find effective solutions to challenges.
Efficient and Organised: You manage your time effectively, prioritise tasks, and maintain a high level of efficiency in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Server Networking Security (Rust)
jobs.desc:
Come join the Server Ingress Security team, where we are rearchitecting MongoDB Server’s ingress networking to make MongoDB clusters even more secure. This new team is building the Atlas Network Protection layer, a set of performant, security-critical services that harden MongoDB's pre-authentication attack surface and provides the ability to respond rapidly to emergent threats. We are looking for talented Senior Engineers to join the team and be founding members, where you will play a crucial role in our multi-year roadmap.
Our team champions a strong culture of inclusivity, diversity, and collaboration. If you want to work on a collaborative team that applies security and systems engineering fundamentals to protect a popular database at scale, join us!
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.
Candidate Profile
5+ years of experience building production-quality systems software
Experience with large backend/compiled codebases and performance-sensitive software, preferably in Rust
Bonus points for experience working hands-on in security-sensitive or networking-adjacent domains
Strong systems fundamentals, including multi-threaded programming and performance profiling. Bonus points for:
Understanding of network protocols, TLS, and connection lifecycle management
Familiarity with security concepts such as attack surface reduction, input validation, memory safety, and defense-in-depth architectures
Excellent verbal and written technical communication skills, with a strong desire to collaborate with colleagues
Strong time management skills and the ability to realistically assess project complexity
B.Sc. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design/architecture. Interest in the theory and practice of high-availability, security-critical systems
Position Expectations
Design, implement, and operate production-ready security services in Rust, with a focus on security, correctness, performance, and operational excellence
Develop ingress networking and security solutions that ensure the security, availability, and performance of a database service
Diagnose test failures and performance regressions, and implement fixes
Lead development and project management for features and initiatives within the Ingress Security domain
Collaborate across Server, Atlas, Drivers, SRE, and Product Security teams to ensure the Atlas Network Protection layer integrates seamlessly with the broader MongoDB ecosystem
Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering leadership to define the team's roadmap
Success Measures
In the first month: Understand the high-level architecture of the Atlas Network Protection layer, set up your development environment, and resolve a few bugs
In three months: Contribute substantially to the Rust development of a current project or milestone, take on code review responsibilities, and participate in reviewing designs for new features
In six months: Independently lead the development of a new feature and help mentor new engineers on the team
In twelve months: Drive significant improvements to the security, performance, or operational capabilities of the Ingress Security stack, and contribute to the long-term technical roadmap of the team
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.desc:
The Opportunity
THE OPPORTUNITY
At Stantec Ireland, you’ll join a growing Energy team at the forefront of a transforming transmission and distribution sector. With rising demand and ambitious decarbonisation targets across Ireland , this is an opportunity to contribute to critical infrastructure shaping the energy transition.
As an Electrical Engineer specialising in HV cable design, you’ll work on a diverse range of projects including HVDC interconnectors, offshore and onshore wind, substations, and grid connections—supporting initiatives aligned with EirGrid ’s network development.
You’ll collaborate within a multidisciplinary team across all project stages, from FEED to delivery, contributing technical expertise while developing your career in a supportive, innovation-driven environment.
About The Role
You will take on a key role within our growing Energy team, supporting the design and delivery of high-voltage cable systems across a range of major infrastructure and renewable energy projects throughout Ireland .
Working as part of a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment, you will contribute to projects spanning HVDC interconnectors, offshore and onshore wind farms, substations, and grid connection schemes. Your responsibilities will include supporting and leading design activities across all project phases—from feasibility and FEED through to detailed design and delivery—ensuring high-quality, efficient, and innovative engineering solutions.
You will work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders, including key clients such as EirGrid , helping to address complex technical challenges and deliver infrastructure that underpins Ireland’s transition to a more sustainable energy future.
This role offers the opportunity to apply your technical expertise, mentor junior engineers, and play an active part in shaping impactful projects, while continuing to develop your career within a supportive and forward-looking organisation.
YOUR IMPACT
In this role, you will help deliver safe, reliable and sustainable water infrastructure for communities across Ireland. Through your expertise in process design, you will develop effective treatment solutions that improve water quality and support resilient systems for the future.
You will assist in the mentorship and training of junior staff throughout there early career stages with Stantec.
Working closely with multidisciplinary teams and clients, you will contribute to innovative, practical solutions across the full project lifecycle. Your work will help ensure designs are efficient, compliant and deliver long-term value while supporting the collaborative culture that defines our team at Stantec.
About You
You are a proactive and technically capable Electrical Engineer with a strong understanding of the electricity transmission and distribution sector.
You will ideally hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (or a related field) from an accredited institution, with membership of Institution of Civil Engineers (EI) is preferred. You bring experience in civil substation engineering and a broad awareness of HV civil engineering projects.
You have hands-on experience in the design of transmission and distribution systems across all stages (Concept, FEED, and Detail Design), applying international standards for utility clients. You can coordinate effectively across disciplines, resolving design issues and ensuring practical, innovative solutions.
Your Technical Skills Include
Cable installation design, including routing layouts, trench/trenchless sections, bonding and phasing, pulling, termination, and jointing arrangements.
Proficiency with CYMCAP software for cable sizing calculations to international standards.
Strong computer literacy in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and design tools such as AutoCAD or MicroStation.
You are adaptable and capable of managing challenging workloads under changing priorities, delivering high-quality results in a dynamic environment.
WHY JOIN US
We put people first: We're proud of our friendly, inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and driven to succeed.
We are driven to achieve: Named in the top 50 companies to work by Glassdoor 2025. Recognised by Corporate Knights as one of the world's top 10 most sustainable companies 2025.
We do what is right: Industry leading training and development as well as paid for professional subscriptions. A professional progression plan, supporting you to become chartered.
We are better together: A supportive and collaborative team environment to assist with the growth of your career.
Growth: We're on an exciting growth journey across the Ireland - we want you to be part of it!
Great Benefits: Competitive salary, enhanced pension plan, annual leave with the option to buy/sell additional days, private medical insurance, group income protection & life assurance included as standard!
About Stantec
Whether you’re starting out on your engineering career or are looking for a fresh challenge, Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, is a great career move.
Based in Dublin, Galway, Castlebar and Cork, we are actively recruiting for team players with experience in any of the following areas – water and wastewater treatment process and network design, integrated network management, structural design, site development, road and bridge engineering, project management and administration.
You’ll be working for a dynamic company with an excellent reputation in the industry.
Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, offers a great working environment amongst friendly professionals with an emphasis on teamwork. It’s a company where your ideas and opinions will be valued and your efforts recognised and rewarded.
We have been awarded the silver Investors in Diversity accreditation by the Irish Centre for Diversity for our commitment to quality, diversity and inclusion (EDI) in the workplace.

Qualifications
Degree in Food Science, Technology or Biotechnology, Production/Process Engineering, or another relevant technical or scientific field.

jobs.title: Healthcare Assistant
jobs.desc:
Healthcare Assistant – Cork – (Job Ref: 26/HCCK)
Randox Health continues to be at the forefront of clinical diagnostics, dedicated to improving health worldwide with our disruptive technology and innovative diagnostic solutions. Our staff are at the heart of everything we do and achieve. We have an exciting new career opportunity for a
Healthcare Assistant
within our clinic in the Holland and Barrett store in Cork.
What does the Randox Health team do?
At Randox Health we encourage individuals to adopt a personalised, preventative approach to their health and well-being, ultimately helping them to live healthier for longer. Using Randox revolutionary technology we measure hundreds of health biomarkers, generating unrivalled data that when combined with our complex algorithms can predict future health concerns and identify early signs of illness even before symptoms arise. This empowers individuals to act sooner to prevent or delay disease onset – moving from a model of sickness management to true preventative healthcare. Our unique biomarker tracking service allows you to establish a health baseline from which you can track and monitor improvements over time.
Location:
43-44 St Patrick's St, Centre, Cork, T12 FY05, Ireland.
Contract Offered:
Full time, permanent.
Working Hours / Shifts:
8.40am to 5.20pm, alternating between a Monday to Friday and Tuesday to Saturday shift pattern. Some flexibility may be required.
For this position, as you may be in contact with live blood samples, you must be vaccinated against Hepatitis B or be able to get it following a successful interview stage.
In line with Care Quality Commission guidelines, the successful candidate will be required to undergo a Garda vetting background check.
What does this role involve?
This role is responsible for ensuring customers have an excellent experience from the moment they enter our clinic, taking blood samples from both private and corporate clients. This is a varied role that may also include the following responsibilities:
Conduct comprehensive client appointments, including blood and urine sample collection, personal health measurements, and data entry into our Patient Information Systems (PIS).
Demonstrate sensitive communication to ensure client understanding and consent.
Maintain accurate records in PIS, uploading all relevant documentation.
Represent the company professionally at offsite events and appointments.
Engage in upselling and cross-selling at our private health clinic.
Proactively drive sales and exceed targets.
Help with reception, front of house and other administrative duties.
Complete company forms, specimen labelling, and laboratory test order forms accurately.
Demonstrate high IT literacy in order to manager various software systems and daily tasks.
Essential criteria:
Previous experience within either a healthcare or customer service environment.
Confident using IT programmes.
Flexibility with working hours, as required by the business inclusive of evenings and weekends.
Flexibility to work from offsite locations at least once per month.
Strong communication skills.
Currently have the right to work in Ireland without visa sponsorship.
Desirable:
Previous Phlebotomy experience and certificate or equivalent training.
Experience in a private healthcare setting.
Experience in customer service.
6 months experience in Phlebotomy.
Sales / Retail experience.
Valid Irish driving licence.
How do I apply?
Click Apply on the site of this advertisement. You will then submit your CV to Randox for review. This advert may be open for as long as 30 days, although we may close the advert early, if we receive sufficient applicants.

jobs.title: AppleCare Service & Support Operations Graduate programme
jobs.desc:
Summary
Apple is a place where extraordinary people gather to do their best work. Together we build products and experiences people once couldn’t have envisioned - and now can’t imagine living without. Are you excited by the idea of making a real impact? Are you prepared to dream big? Then a career with Apple might be your dream job.
Apple, Cork has a fantastic graduate opportunity to work within our AppleCare department, this position will give the you excellent development opportunities within a global company to build the career you always wanted! AppleCare, Cork is responsible for managing customer service and support for the entire EMEIA region.
The goal of the AppleCare organisation is to provide world-class technical support and service to the extensive installed base of Mac & iOS products and associated services. We are looking for astute, energetic graduates to work across a number of AppleCare Departments undertaking 5 rotations during a 23 month period.
The departments you will work in may include Product Repair and Service management, Customer support, Service Channel Management, Materials and Planning, Business Process Re-engineering, Data Analytics, Engineering & Quality.
This is an outstanding opportunity to gain valuable experience across a highly matrixed organisation. Graduates of Business Information Systems, Supply Chain, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science/Analytics or any similar business disciplines are of particular interest. If you feel you have the critical skills required, we would love to hear from you.
Description
You will rotate through 5 AppleCare departments some of which are outlined below to assist in the ongoing management and development of the extensive AppleCare operations functions supporting our customer base.
Duties will include providing support functions to the various teams, developing and presenting business reports, investigating and solving technical and process problems, managing projects etc. There will likely be an opportunity to travel to various customer support and service partner operations within Europe at various points in the programme.
This role will involve extensive multi-functional teamwork and challenge your array of hard and soft skills daily. The AppleCare environment is a dynamic, fast-paced and complex operation, so the opportunity to learn and develop is immense.
Below is a brief description of each of the participating departments :
Product Repair and Service Management - Responsible for managing the extensive range of service providers and repair factories across the EMEIA region. These providers generally are the partners to AppleCare who provide hardware repair services for our customers.
Customer Support - A number of departments in AppleCare provide the management and support to ensure our customers get outstanding technical support for our products and services.
Service Channel Management - This team provides extensive management and oversight to the different channels that our customers have for service, either directly with Apple or through our partner network.
Service Supply Chain Operations (SSCO) - All of the parts and components required to keep the extensive service repairs network going are planned and procured by this department.
Business Process Reengineering - This group provides the project and programme management services to develop our comprehensive systems and process network supporting the different AppleCare business groups.
Data Analytics - Data analysis is a critical part of ensuring that our business functions are operating as effectively and efficiently as possible. This team develops the tools and perform the essential services to analyse big data for all business groups within AppleCare.
Minimum Qualifications
Will have achieved or expected to achieve a 2:1 or higher overall grade in undergraduate degree programme or MSc.
Preferred Qualifications
Highly motivated self-starter with consistent record of delivering results through team work.
Strong data analytics skills & a data driven approach
Good knowledge of any of SQL, Excel, Tableau or Power BI
Excellent time management and prioritisation skills
Outstanding interpersonal skills
Superb communication skills both verbal & written
Be able to function comfortably in a fast-paced, pressurised & highly information sensitive environment
Good problem-solving skills, being able to make informed & timely decisions.
At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.

General Summary
General Summary:
Qualcomm is leveraging its strengths in compute, connectivity, and AI acceleration to play a central role in the evolution of Cloud AI. The Qualcomm Cloud AI team develops hardware and software platforms enabling efficient inference of large-scale foundation models.
We are seeking a Staff Engineer – AI Model Optimization Architect to lead end-to-end model transformation and optimization for LLMs, VLMs, diffusion, and multimodal models on Qualcomm inference accelerators. This role works closely with compiler, performance, and accuracy teams to translate models into accelerator efficient execution while balancing throughput, latency, memory, and quality. The scope spans Day0 enablement through production deployment, with a strong emphasis on scaling optimizations to future architectures.
Key Responsibilities
Architect and deliver model optimization strategies that transform PyTorch models for efficient inference on Qualcomm accelerators.
Drive graph capture and deployment using PyTorch, ONNX, and torch.compile, including model rewrites and graph-level transformations.
Design and implement fusion kernels using DSL based approaches (e.g., Triton), enabling fused operations and performance critical algorithmic rewrites.
Partner deeply with compiler, performance, and accuracy teams to co-design lowering strategies, kernel fusion, layout decisions, and runtime integration.
Profile and optimize LLM/VLM/diffusion inference for throughput and latency across batch sizes, sequence lengths, and serving modes.
Own transformer specific optimizations including KVcache management, decoding behavior, and long context performance.
Enable and optimize continuous batching (dynamic/iteration-level scheduling), understanding its impact on memory, scheduling, and tail latency.
Architect and scale distributed inference strategies (e.g., sharding and parallelism) across multi-core and multi-device systems.
Establish reusable approaches to scale model optimizations to new hardware architectures, creating robust patterns and tooling.
Debug complex performance or stability issues to root cause and drive production ready solutions.
Required Qualifications
Expert level expertise in PyTorch and inference focused model optimization; strong Python engineering skills.
Hands on experience with torch.compile / TorchDynamo or related graph capture and compilation workflows.
Deep understanding of transformer architectures, attention mechanisms, MoEs, and performance trade-offs.
Practical experience with KVcache behavior, serving time optimizations, and memory/performance tradeoffs.
Strong foundation in computer architecture, ML accelerators, and distributed systems.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical efforts and influence design decisions.
MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Preferred / Bonus Qualifications
Experience developing fusion kernels using Triton or similar DSLs, and collaborating with ML compiler teams.
Familiarity with LLM serving stacks and continuous batching systems.
Background in numerical methods, performance/accuracy trade-off analysis, or evaluation frameworks.

Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 5+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.
The Role:
We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end user journey for Aiven's self-serve customer base. This role is deeply focused on what happens after someone signs up — turning new users into activated ones, activated users into paying customers, and paying customers into expanded accounts.
You'll combine segmentation, behavioural data, and personalised messaging to build a lifecycle program that drives measurable monetisation outcomes. This includes everything from in-console nudges to nurture flows to expansion signals.
What You'll Do:
Own the full user lifecycle from sign-up through activation, conversion, retention, and expansion
Design and execute nurture programs tailored to where users are in their journey — onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and milestone-based triggers
Build and manage in-console messaging and product nudges in partnership with Product — surfacing the right prompt to the right user at the right moment
Develop and maintain user segmentation frameworks based on product usage, firmographics, and behavioural signals
Drive monetisation programs: identifying users with high conversion or expansion potential and delivering targeted interventions (upgrade prompts, usage-based triggers, tier nudges)
Work closely with Product and Data teams to define the signals that indicate activation, health, and churn risk — and build automated responses to them
Own lifecycle reporting: activation rates, conversion rates, expansion revenue influenced, and churn metrics
What We're Looking For:
Proven experience in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, ideally at a SaaS or PLG company
Deep understanding of user journey mapping and funnel-based thinking
You're highly data-driven, you can build a cohort, read a funnel, and turn behavioural signals into a clear hypothesis worth testing.
Experience with marketing automation and lifecycle tooling (e.g. Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or similar)
Familiarity with in-product messaging tools (e.g. Intercom, Pendo, or similar) is a strong plus
Strong collaboration skills, this role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Data
Amazing! What’s next:
If you think Aiven is the place for you and that our Values align with yours, send us your resume and we’ll get in touch!
AI Usage:
Aiven does not use AI to screen and/or select applicants. However, you will have the opportunity to demonstrate your AI proficiency during the live challenge stage of our interview process.
Global Benefits:
Our global benefits are designed to help you thrive and grow, personally and professionally:
Participate in Aiven’s equity plan.
Balance work and life with our hybrid work policy.
Choose the equipment you need to set yourself up for success.
Use your Professional Development Plan budget for learning opportunities.
Receive holistic wellbeing support through our global Employee Assistance Program.
Inquire about our Global Time Off Commitment (Parental and Sick Leave, as well as Personal Time)
Enjoy country-specific benefits for our global cast. (BitQuery DB)
How to Recognize and Avoid Employment Scams:
There has been a rise in fake job postings used by scammers to get personal information. At Aiven, all of our emails relating to recruitment come from an @aiven.io, @greenhouse.io or @eu.greenhouse.io domain and all of our interviews are conducted by video call or in person. Our interviews will never occur via text or chat. If you’re unsure of the legitimacy of a job opportunity/offer pertaining to Aiven, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at recruitment@aiven.io.
Equal Opportunities:
Aiven provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, physical and mental ability, marital and family status or without regard to any other similar personal attributes. Aiven complies with applicable local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company operates. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, training and any other terms and conditions related to employment.
At Aiven we are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities or special needs in our working environment and job application procedures. We make all reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities or who otherwise need support to thrive in the workplace. We are committed to continuously improving workplace accessibility. There is an option to request a discussion in the application process but if you have any questions before applying please write to us at recruitment@aiven.io.
